title: Ordinal-Entropy Regime Switch
description: A sliding permutation-entropy estimate of return predictability gates which of two mirror modes is live: fade extremes when returns look like noise, ride drift when they look persistent. One gate replaces a parameter sweep over lookbacks.
entry_conditions: Long when entropy above high band and return z-score below -2
Long when entropy below low band and 10-bar drift z-score above 1.5
exit_conditions: Exit on z-score zero-cross or entropy regime flip
Exit after 48 bars or 3 ATR adverse move

risk_management.position_sizing: Quarter Kelly of edge estimate, capped 1.5x equity

rationale: Permutation entropy separates predictable drift from noise without distributional assumptions, so it is a regime classifier rather than a fitted signal. Reversion and momentum are mirror images; gating on entropy harvests whichever dominates and deletes the whipsaw trades that kill fixed-mode systems.
